measure.measure_definition: Measured value: LVEF by cardiac magnetic resonance imaging at 6 months.; Participants; CMR at 3 T (Achieva; Philips Medical Systems) at baseline and 6 months; short-axis imaging used for primary LVEF analysis; long-axis images used in 10 participants with suboptimal short-axis images; core laboratory analysis with CVI42 by a cardiologist blinded to treatment. Adjusted least-squares means from linear mixed-effects models with maximum likelihood, including treatment group, timepoint and treatment × time, with adjustment for age, sex, race/ethnicity, NYHA class, HF etiology, HF chronicity, eGFR, baseline NT-proBNP and baseline value.; LVEF at 6 months in the modified intention-to-treat population with baseline and 6-month CMR (n = 187; excludes 25 without follow-up CMR). Between-group difference is polypill minus enhanced usual care; higher LVEF indicates better cardiac function.

Occurrence: rate of HF hospitalization or ED visit for HF (recurrent event episodes per 100 person-years).; Events; Clinical event ascertainment over 6 months; person-time from randomization to final study visit, loss to follow-up or death; quasi-Poisson regression with person-time offset for rate ratios; adjusted model as reported.; HF hospitalization or ED visit for HF counted as recurrent event episodes and expressed per 100 person-years; clinical event analyses included all 212 randomized participants, censoring at last follow-up, loss to follow-up or death. Adjusted rate ratio compares polypill with enhanced usual care.
measure.measure_name: Heart-failure hospitalization or emergency-department visit for heart failure

measure.measure_definition: Categorical status: adherent by TDM, defined as detectable serum levels of all tested medications.; Participants; Follow-up serum samples; quantitative liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry for serum metoprolol and spironolactone; adherent if detectable levels of all tested medications, nonadherent if any tested medication undetectable; Poisson regression with log link for adjusted rate ratio.; TDM adherence at follow-up among participants with available follow-up serum samples (n = 186). measure.measure_name: Medication adherence by therapeutic drug monitoring of serum metoprolol and spironolactone
